ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows four congruent unit squares arranged in a stair-step shape: two squares along the bottom row and two squares along the top row shifted one unit to the right. Point P is at the lower-left corner of the left bottom square, and point Q is at the upper-right corner of the right top square. Reasoning: Assign coordinates with P = (0,0). From P to Q, the horizontal displacement is 3 unit lengths and the vertical displacement is 2 unit lengths, so Q = (3,2). Using the distance formula, PQ = sqrt((3 - 0)^2 + (2 - 0)^2) = sqrt(9 + 4) = sqrt(13).
